email.spf fail

SPF

10-11

The domain's SPF record is missing or invalid, leaves out the addresses of MX hosts the domain operates itself, or lacks -all although the domain publishes a Null MX.

Fix: Publish one SPF record that lists every server sending mail for the domain, including its own MX hosts that also send, and ends in -all, or ~all where the domain does not publish a Null MX.

HSTS

10-11

Fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security with max-age=31536000 on all HTTPS responses.
